in_marathi.name: Jitu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jitu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jitu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jit', which means 'victory' or 'conqueror'. In Hindu mythology, Jitu is a name given to gods and heroes who have achieved victory over their enemies or challenges. It is a name that embodies strength, courage, and triumph.
